name: Mikasa (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Mikasa city emblem in yellow: a ring open at the bottom enclosing a smaller ring with a stalk.
history: Municipal flag of Mikasa, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 March 1957.

features.role: Mikasa city emblem — a ring open at the bottom enclosing a smaller ring with a stalk
